rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Written only four days earlier for another departing Cabinet secretary, it uses a closely parallel opening that combines acceptance of the resignation, the identical January 20 effective date, and praise for a “distinguished contribution.” Both letters then review achievements in the official’s substantive portfolio, connect national security with peace, justice, and freedom, add personal gratitude, and close with wishes for the official and his family. C03 and C23 share the same transition-period resignation-letter structure, but their language and substantive progression are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As I accept your resignation, concluding your official service in this vital and important field as of January twentieth, I pay tribute to both your ability and devotion.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Defense, effective January 20, 1961, I assure you of my deep appreciation and admiration of the distinguished contribution you have made
shared_material.explanation: The openings use the same concrete drafting unit: acceptance of a Cabinet secretary’s resignation, the January 20 effective date, and immediate praise for distinguished service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you have made a distinguished contribution
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the distinguished contribution you have made
shared_material.explanation: This is a close verbal correspondence in the central evaluative phrase.

shared_material.child_excerpt: we have demonstrated our will for peace, while safeguarding security and furthering justice and freedom
shared_material.parent_excerpt: we maintain these forces for purposes that are entirely peaceful--to preserve security, justice and freedom
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the official’s accomplishments through the same linked concepts of peaceful purpose, security, justice, and freedom.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You have my best wishes for happy years ahead for yourself and your family.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: My very best wishes to you and your family now and in the future
shared_material.explanation: The concluding personal wishes are closely parallel and directed to both the official and his family.
